definition: Unique source observation identifier; not a predictive feature.
Experimental block label; retained for validation/diagnostics, not a default predictor.
Categorical experimental/feed identifier; retained for grouping. Raw sample_id is not a default predictor because labels encode experimental state.
Categorical pre-process/feed-state descriptor: Roasted or Unroasted.
Redundant with feed_type in this formulation; retained for traceability.
Pre-process bauxite Al2O3 percentage.
Pre-process bauxite SiO2 percentage.
Derived as Al2O3/SiO2. Compare inclusion versus exclusion; do not automatically use all three chemistry variables together.
Explicit identity of the first experimental factor; categorical.
Numeric value of factor_1. Structural NaN is preserved where no numeric value is present.
Unit associated with factor_1; retained as metadata because factor identity determines the unit.
Explicit indicator that factor_1 has an observed numeric value; this is encoding of experimental structure, not imputation.
Explicit identity of the second experimental factor; needed for the two-factor roasting block.
Numeric value of factor_2. Structural NaN is preserved where no numeric value is present.
Unit associated with factor_2; retained as metadata.
Explicit indicator that factor_2 has an observed numeric value; this is encoding of experimental structure, not imputation.
Number of factor slots represented in the Phase 4B formulation; retained for audit.
Continuous supervised-regression target in percent.
Validation grouping key derived from sample_id.
Validation grouping key derived from sample_id and block.
Validation grouping key derived from feed_type.
Validation grouping key derived from feed_type and factor_1_name.
Validation grouping key based on exact bauxite Al2O3, SiO2 and A/S values.
Validation grouping key equal to experimental block.
